note: The ceiling on the bytes of target/release/brokkr as CI's release-binary job builds it (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, rust 1.98.0, --locked, [profile.release] as the root Cargo.toml leaves it). The operator ruled a 30 MB ceiling on 2026-10-01, in place of a committed size held within one per cent either way, and raised it to 32 MB on 2026-10-18 (PR #745), when main stood within 47 KB of 30 MB with thirteen units of decision 0065's second slice to come. Measurements: 30,256,664 bytes from PR #745 at 16760fe2 on 2026-10-18 (U8a2a, the writer lease); 29,953,392 from the merge group of PR #741 at 78d980c7 on 2026-10-18; 22,167,000 bytes from PR #510 at abbea75d on 2026-10-01 (the TUI's fleet at 4K and its one run view); 21,931,184 from PR #319 at 5df5966c on 2026-09-30 (decision 0065's first slice); 20,152,912 from PR #483 at 0c9df16f on 2026-09-28. scripts/binary-size.sh refuses a build past the ceiling and prints every build's size. A local build embeds different source paths and is not comparable.
